integrity: The primary full text was checked at the Main Theorem, the companion definition, the explicit failure of amalgamation, Proposition 4.12, and Example 5.1. The proof embeds the two source groups into models of the model companion and compares their parameter-free quantifier-free one-types directly from the syntax of one-variable group terms. No computation or finite experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns quantifier elimination in the pure group language. It does not rule out quantifier elimination in an expansion, does not classify the full definability complexity of the central series, and does not alter the existence or decidability of the model companion.
title: The exponent-three group model companion fails one-variable quantifier elimination
